infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aura uses the camera to record Swift videos and take photos for your stories and chat messages. Nothing is captured until you press record or the shutter.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aura uses the microphone to record sound with your Swift videos. Audio is only captured while you are recording, and only in the video you choose to publish.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aura lets you choose an existing photo for your profile picture, a story, or a chat message. Only the photo you pick is shared — Aura never reads your library.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: You asked Aura to keep sharing while the app is closed. Only while you are sharing, Aura keeps your position current in the background so people nearby see where you are and you are told when someone is close. It stops the moment you turn that switch off, choose Paused, or close Aura. This is optional, and nothing else in Aura asks for it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Aura uses your location to show you people nearby who share your interests. Sharing starts Paused every time you open Aura: while it is Paused your location answers only your own searches and is never saved or shown to anyone. You are shown to other people only after you choose Live or Approximate yourself, on a screen explaining what that means, and it ends when you choose Paused or close Aura.
